say.Z times X is minus X times Z: zee times ex is minus ex times zee

scenes.name: ONE PLANE
lines: Last time, lifting our eyes turned a line back into a turning disc.
上一部里，我们抬起视线，一条线重新展开成一张转动的圆盘。
Today's question: is one flat plane enough for a qubit?
今天的问题：一张平面，装得下一个量子比特吗？

scenes.name: THREE AXES
lines: In the lab, a spin can be measured along three directions, all at right angles.
在实验室里，自旋可以沿三个方向丈量，三个方向两两垂直。
Three axes give three planes, all crossing at right angles.
三根轴给出三张平面，两两成直角相交。
Every arrow of length one now ends on a sphere.
现在，每一支长度为 1 的箭头，箭尖都落在一颗球面上。
Standard theory puts every pure qubit state on this sphere; that is a literature result.
标准量子理论把单量子比特的每个纯态都放在这颗球面上；这是文献结果。

scenes.name: ONE TABLE PER POINT
lines: Each point of the sphere comes with its own two-by-two table of numbers.
球面上的每一个点，都配着一张属于自己的二乘二数表。
The north pole gives the table called Z; the point on the x axis gives X.
北极给出名叫 Z 的数表；x 轴上的那个点给出 X。
Multiply any such table by itself, and you get the identity: ones on the diagonal.
任何一张这样的数表与自己相乘，都得到单位表：对角线上是 1，其余是 0。

scenes.name: TWO ANGLES
lines: To find a point, use two angles: first tilt down from the north, then turn around.
要找到球面上的一个点，用两个角：先从北极往下倾，再绕竖轴转。
Keep the tilt fixed and only turn: the point walks a small circle, a latitude.
倾角固定、只转动：点走的是一个小圆，也就是纬圈。
Only at ninety degrees does its plane pass through the centre: that is the equator.
只有倾角到 90°，它所在的平面才经过球心：那就是赤道。
Going around once is not the same as covering the sphere.
绕一圈，还不等于走遍球面。

scenes.name: ORDER MATTERS
lines: On a sphere, the order of two turns matters.
在球面上，两次转动的先后顺序有讲究。
A quarter turn about x, then about z, lands on the x axis.
先绕 x 轴转四分之一圈，再绕 z 轴转四分之一圈：落在 x 轴上。
Swap the order, and we land somewhere else, a right angle away.
调换顺序，就落到别处，与刚才相隔一个直角。
The readout tables feel the order too: Z times X is minus X times Z.
读数表也感觉得到顺序：Z 乘 X 等于负的 X 乘 Z。
The green results in this film are checked by the Lean kernel.
片中绿色的结论，都由 Lean 内核检验。

scenes.name: RECAP
lines: One plane holds one turn; a qubit needs three axes and a sphere.
一张面只装得下一种转动；量子比特要三根轴、一颗球。
Two angles give an address; a fixed tilt walks only a latitude.
两个角给出地址；固定倾角只走一圈纬线。
On a sphere, order matters: Z times X is minus X times Z.
在球上，顺序有讲究：ZX = −XZ。
Next: who can point outside the sphere?
下一部：谁能指向球的外面？
